name: postcard-pop-up
js: state.background.kind = "castle"; changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); setSavePop(true)

name: postcard-duck-pond
js: state.background.kind = "lake"; changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); const b = await postcardBlob("Greetings from the duck pond!"); const im = document.createElement('img'); im.src = URL.createObjectURL(b); im.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;margin:auto;max-width:94vw;max-height:94vh;z-index:9999;box-shadow:0 0 0 100vmax rgba(0,0,0,0.55)'; document.body.append(im)

name: postcard-castle-mood-line
js: state.background.kind = "castle"; changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); const b = await postcardBlob(document.getElementById('mood').textContent); const im = document.createElement('img'); im.src = URL.createObjectURL(b); im.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;margin:auto;max-width:94vw;max-height:94vh;z-index:9999;box-shadow:0 0 0 100vmax rgba(0,0,0,0.55)'; document.body.append(im)
